question: What transformed state arises from meditating on the beloved woman at beginning and end?
premises: Meditation occurs at beginning and end.
One becomes consisting of Śiva and Śakti.
inference: Meditating on the beloved woman at beginning and end makes one Śiva-Śakti in nature.
plain_english: Having meditated on the beloved woman at the beginning and end, one should become consisting of Śiva and Śakti.
